title: Nodes as labelled documents
statement: The system shall store each entity as a node with a unique identifier, zero or more labels, and a property document that may contain nested records and lists.
rationale: PO: data is a graph of entities with nested attributes. Owned, identity-less attributes nest inside the node; shared or independently identified things become separate nodes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A node with 3 labels and properties nested 5 levels deep (records within lists within records) is inserted and returned unchanged by MATCH on its identifier.
Inserting a node whose identifier already exists fails with a uniqueness error.
